title: A small SVG icon opens big enough to work on
goal: An SVG of 16, 20, 32 or 48 points opens at 100 percent as a speck in the middle of the window, so someone who opens an icon has to zoom before they can see it. It should open filling the window, and a square icon on another grid should get the Icon tools a 24 unit one gets.
notes: Reproduced 2026-11-07 on the probe: a walk opening a 16x16 SVG logged 'small16.svg: document 16x16 at pixelScale 1.0; window 1100x800 pt; canvas 835x768 pt; zoom 1.000', and 1-small-sc.png shows a 16 point square alone in the window. Viewport.fit never enlarges. Of 431 real SVGs on this Mac, 37 are 16x16, 20 are 14x14, 16 are 48x48 and 10 are 22x22. Only the 24 grid opens as an Icon picture today (SVGOpening.isIcon); 512 must stay an ordinary picture, since pictureIconUnit would rewrite it as 24 units on export. Found by opening-an-svg-file-gives-you-its-drawing-to-edi.
acceptance: A 16 by 16 SVG opens filling the window, with no zoom step by the person
Fit (Command 0) on that document gives the same view, and a 300 by 120 logo still opens at 100 percent
A walk with no flags shows it, and the window picture goes in the audit

log.note: digest 2026-11-07 spot check, moved to p1 for the focus: a walk opening a 16 by 16 SVG logged 'small16.svg: document 16x16 at pixelScale 1.0 ... zoom 1.000' at ce764ec4, so it still opens as a speck.

Chose opening a small square SVG as a 512 point Icon picture on its own grid over zooming a 16 point canvas up, because a 16 point canvas stops at the 32x zoom limit and would not get the Icon tools. Its view is the one a 24 unit icon gets: 59 percent of canvas height at 1280x900, so 'filling the window' is my judgement call, not a measured pass; it is the first question in the audit.

Verified: walk a-small-svg-opens-big-enough-walk green with no flags; opening-an-svg-walk and a-saved-icon-opens-as-an-icon-walk green. Open and Fit pictures differ only by the zoom control pill (pixel diff, box 1689,1707 to 2006,1776). Order slip: the tests were written in the same step as the code, not run red first; the walk reproduced the speck beforehand at zoom 1.000.

Scripts/test.sh: 5 runs on this tree, 3 red then 2 green. Red: VideoCutExportTests x3 (reader gave up), plus LiveBackdropRenderTests 16 ms budget once. Control on clean HEAD 93572bcc: 1 green, 1 red (dragTheWidth). Failed tests pass alone. Noted on the-full-test-suite-stays-green-on-a-busy-mac-wh. The VideoCut failures hit 3 of 5 here and 0 of 2 on HEAD, too few runs to prove anything either way.

left rough: Ask's IconGridLanding is 24 units only, read in code and not tried on another grid. Small non-square files and squares over 64 still open at 100 percent. Neither filed: the first is unreproduced, the second is outside this task's acceptance; both are in the audit for the user to react to.
